title: 1800 sqft Office Space in Connaught Place, Delhi
description: A premium commercial office space available for sale in the heart of Delhi's most prestigious business district — Connaught Place. This 1800 sqft office on the ground floor offers a prime retail/business presence with high footfall and excellent visibility. The space features a professional reception area, two private cabins for senior management, a large open-plan work area for 20-25 workstations, a conference room with AV setup, a pantry/break area, and two washrooms. The property has a dedicated entrance from the main road with signage rights. 3-phase power connection with UPS backup, high-speed fiber internet connectivity, centralized air conditioning, and fire safety systems are all installed and operational. Connaught Place offers unmatched connectivity with the Rajiv Chowk metro station at walking distance, making it accessible from all parts of Delhi-NCR. Ideal for IT/ITES companies, corporate offices, co-working space operators, retail showrooms, banks, or professional services firms. The area also attracts significant foot traffic for restaurants and retail businesses.
